Doctor’s Comments
Ideal Saline Breast Implants were used by Dr. Gregory Park, Oceanside plastic surgeon, for this breast enhancement surgery. She did not want to have breast lift because of scars and opted for a breast augmentation alone. 335 cc saline breast implants filled to a final volume of 375 cc were placed through inframammary incisions in dual plane split submuscular pockets increasing this patient’s bra size from 34A to 34C.  She is very happy with her results. Her before and after photos show her breast augmentation results 3 months after her surgery.
